description.value: The Keg Steakhouse + Bar in Prince George has occupied the same corner at 6th and George Street, across from City Hall, since 1976, making it one of the longest-running locations in the chain. The single-level building offers a covered patio, private dining room, bar, and lounge, all within walking distance of the downtown hotel district. It is wheelchair accessible and serves as a full-service evening dining destination in the heart of Prince George.
